clue.text: Fail in court recess

indicators.note: in says the word for failing goes inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: to fail is to lose

explanation.surface: A case collapsing during a break in the court's sitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A cupboard set into an alcove is a recess in a wall used for storage.

clue.text: Using a little plunger, take a breather

indicators.note: a little says only part of the following word is used, its inner letters

explanation.surface: Pausing for breath while clearing a drain with a plunger.
explanation.definitionFit: This organ is what breathes in a body, so it is literally a breather.

clue.text: Lose concentration, so stop watching TV

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to stop attending mentally and to turn off an appliance such as a television.

clue.text: Each in sequence for drink dispenser

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for each inside the word for sequence

parts.note: a turn is one's place in a sequence, as in taking turns

explanation.surface: Everyone takes their turn at the drinks dispenser.
explanation.definitionFit: A large metal container with a tap, used for serving hot tea to many people.

clue.text: To sleep, say, on bed, one may lie on one's back

definitions.text: one may lie on one's back

indicators.note: say signals that the word for sleeping is only spoken, so a silent-K spelling with the same pronunciation is used

parts.note: to nap is to sleep briefly
sack is slang for bed, as in hitting the sack

explanation.surface: Advice on bedding down for the night, lying on one's back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just sets the sleep word before the bed word.
explanation.definitionFit: A rucksack is carried on the wearer's back, so it lies there while walking.

clue.text: Not concede one has to store spare bed linen

definitions.meaning: in football, to let in no goals

definitions.text: one has to store spare bed linen
definitions.meaning: literally, to retain an unused sheet in reserve

explanation.definitionFit: The football idiom for conceding no goals, read literally, means retaining an unused bed sheet.

clue.text: Does one deserve a lighter sentence?

definitions.text: Does one deserve a lighter sentence?

parts.words: Does one deserve a lighter sentence?
parts.note: seems to ask about leniency, but 'lighter' means one who lights fires

explanation.definitionFit: A person who deliberately sets fires is a lighter, and would be sentenced for the crime.

clue.text: Knowing, for example, about two volumes

indicators.note: about says the word for example goes around the abbreviations for two volumes

parts.note: say introduces an example, as in 'take, say, London'
V is an abbreviation for volume, so two volumes give V twice

explanation.surface: A knowledgeable reader knows a couple of books, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrewd and well informed, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Party getting together, not rebelling

parts.note: CON is short for the Conservative party
forming, as a group comes together

explanation.surface: A party convening, with nobody in revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: Complying with rules or norms is the opposite of rebelling against them.

clue.text: Friendly hint

definitions.meaning: close and familiar, as an adjective
to suggest something indirectly, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means very close and familiar; the verb, stressed differently, means to suggest without stating.

clue.text: Protecting goalie's job

definitions.meaning: a goalkeeper's task is stopping shots, each one a save

explanation.definitionFit: Rescuing or preserving something is protecting it, and stopping shots is the keeper's work in football.

clue.text: Only interact corruptly? No way

indicators.note: corruptly says the letters of these two words are bent out of their proper order

explanation.surface: A refusal to deal only with crooked dealings: no way.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are emphatic refusals, idioms meaning under no circumstances.

clue.text: Reporting for work

parts.note: seems to mean arriving at one's job, but means news reporting done as a profession

explanation.definitionFit: Writing news stories as a career is literally reporting carried out for one's living.

clue.text: Traffic lights always red? Not possible

definitions.meaning: if the lights never change, traffic can never proceed
an undertaking that cannot be done or allowed

explanation.definitionFit: A forbidden or impossible area or plan is a no-go, and permanent red lights would forbid all going.

clue.text: Previously, but never again?

definitions.meaning: on the most recent occasion before now
a final occasion, after which there will be no more

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the previous occasion or the final occasion ever, two senses of the same words.

clue.text: A misfortune in constricted part of car

indicators.note: in puts the article and the word for misfortune inside the word for constricted

parts.note: tight means squeezed or constricted
an ill is a misfortune or trouble

explanation.surface: A mishap in a cramped spot inside a car.
explanation.definitionFit: The red lamp at the rear of a vehicle is one of its parts.

clue.text: Part of the Union in a right state

parts.note: Kansas is a US state

explanation.surface: A member of the federal union in a real mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a right state' reads as British idiom for flustered, but splits into a, right and a state.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the fifty states making up the United States, often called the Union.

clue.text: Invoice of a sort for working poor farm

indicators.note: working says the letters of these words are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A bill for labour on a struggling smallholding.
explanation.definitionFit: A preliminary invoice sent before goods are supplied is called by this Latin-derived phrase.

clue.text: Announce I own a place for spiritual retreats

indicators.note: announce says the following words are spoken out and what is heard is entered

parts.note: spoken quickly, these three words run together into one word

explanation.surface: A proud declaration of owning a spot for spiritual retreats.
explanation.definitionFit: This small Hebridean island, home to an abbey and religious community, draws visitors for retreats.

clue.text: Strict, requiring name on pointer

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means the abbreviation for name sits above the pointer

parts.note: an arrow points the way

explanation.surface: A rigid rule demands a label on a signpost.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow interpretation is strict and limited, a sense of the adjective.

clue.text: A British division raised by the Romans

definitions.text: A British division raised by the Romans

parts.words: A British division raised by the Romans
parts.note: sounds like a legion raised in Britain, but it is a frontier barrier built across northern England

explanation.surface: A legion recruited in Britain by the Roman army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'division' and 'raised' suggest troops levied; read instead as a dividing structure erected.
explanation.definitionFit: The emperor's stone fortification divided Roman Britain from the north and was built by Roman soldiers.

clue.text: Pipe up

parts.note: seems to mean start speaking, but means a pipe that runs upward

explanation.definitionFit: In plumbing and drilling, a vertical pipe carrying flow upward has this name.

clue.text: Some advise minister in the House

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few aides counselling a government minister in Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the House' suggests Parliament, where a minister sits, but the definition points to a type of house.
explanation.definitionFit: A semi-detached house is called by this short form, a half house joined to another.

clue.text: Wife, the most beautiful girl in America?

definitions.meaning: informal word for a man's spouse

definitions.text: the most beautiful girl in America?
definitions.meaning: the winner of the national beauty pageant, split as two words

explanation.definitionFit: It is a colloquial term for one's spouse, and read in two parts names the American beauty queen title.

clue.text: A lordly brew?

parts.note: a tea named after a nobleman, a peer ranking above a viscount

explanation.definitionFit: This bergamot-flavoured tea bears a nobleman's title and grey surname, so it is a brew with a lord's name.

clue.text: Fashionable people get new mattress

indicators.note: new says the letters of the bed item are made into something different

explanation.surface: Trendy folk buying themselves a fresh mattress.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for the fashionable elite in society.

clue.text: Trendy humorist has success

parts.note: a wit is a clever, funny person
a hit is a success, like a hit song

explanation.surface: A fashionable comedian enjoys a triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is dated slang for fashionable or up to date.
